turns.message: Where do I go to buy a balisong?
turns.reply: You've got two main options. Hit up /product-world — that's the marketplace search where you can filter by specs like blade material, handle material, pivot system, and price to find knives for sale. Or head to /community and look for Buy/Sell posts where people are listing knives they're selling or trading. Both'll show you what's actually available from the community right now.

turns.message: Where do I go to buy a balisong?
turns.reply:
You've got two main places on BFC depending on what you're after.

If you want to browse what the community's actually selling or trading, check out /community — search the feed for Buy/Sell and Trade posts, or filter by those post types to see what's listed.

If you want a more structured marketplace feel with spec filters (blade material, handle material, pivot system, price range), hit /product-world — that's the real marketplace search where you can narrow down by exactly what you want in a knife.

Both pull from the same community listings, so pick whichever search style clicks for you.
